identity.operation: Link the fuzz target with libcares.a.
identity.condition: The library target is under src/lib/, while the link command names the former root .libs/libcares.a.
identity.capability: Locate and link the archive produced by the src/lib libcares.la target.
identity.consequence: The target cannot link using the supplied archive path.

requirement: Link the archive produced by the src/lib library target.

assessment.necessity_reason: Linking libcares is required to build this fuzz target. The changed Automake target is in src/lib/, but the fixed harness still names the root archive.

before.requirement: Link the archive from the root libcares.la target.
before.reason: The root Makefile defines libcares.la, matching the harness's root archive operand. This assesses the path, not a demonstrated successful build.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The former project test link recipe also names the root library target.

after.requirement: Link the archive from the src/lib libcares.la target.
after.reason: The library target is now defined in src/lib/, and the root Makefile descends into subdirectories. The harness still supplies the root .libs/libcares.a path.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The changed root build delegates to subdirectories.
The changed project test link recipe names src/lib/libcares.la.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same root archive operand corresponds to the before target location but misses the after target location.

necessity_evidence.reason: The old harness links the root .libs/libcares.a archive, while the changed Automake library target is in src/lib/. This is an introduced build path mismatch; the evidence does not claim a successful build before the change.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: Run the supplied build recipe. Its fuzz-target link command uses $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a, while the changed library target is defined in src/lib/Makefile.am. No fuzzer bytes are needed.

scope_contract.reason: Linking libcares is part of the target's build recipe and supplies its parser calls.

evidence.dependency_reason: The entry invokes a libcares parser that the linked archive must provide.

feasible_trigger.reason: The finite build recipe invokes the library build and specifies the stale root archive as the fuzz-target link operand. This build-path condition needs no fuzz input.

evidence.dependency_reason: The changed root build delegates its targets to subdirectories.

observable_consequence.reason: The specified link operand points to the former root archive location rather than the location of the changed libcares target, blocking the target link.

evidence.dependency_reason: The changed project test link rules name src/lib/libcares.la, corroborating the new target location.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete changed root Makefile.am defines subdirectory delegation instead of a root libcares target. The project test link rules also use src/lib/, and the fixed harness has no alternative archive operand for this fuzz target.

evidence.dependency_reason: The library target is defined in src/lib/.
The updated project test rules consistently link the subdirectory target.

identity_preserved.reason: Both sides assess the same obligation: link the archive produced by the libcares target. Before, that target was at the root and matched the harness operand; after, it is under src/lib/ while the operand is unchanged.

evidence.dependency_reason: The former project test rules reference the root libcares target.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete changed root Makefile.am establishes its delegated build layout and lack of a root library target.
The changed project test rules corroborate the src/lib link path.
